info.name: Listrak Cross Channel REST app-push-mobile-client-device MessageLinkClicker API

params.name: listId
params.description: Identifier used to locate the list.

params.name: messageId
params.description: Identifier used to locate the message.

params.name: messageLinkId
params.description: Identifier used to locate the link.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Value indicating the page of data that's being retrieved. The default value is `Start`.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of data members to be displayed per page. The default value is `1000` and the maximum value is `5000`.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Start date that's being used to filter the data members.

params.name: endDate
params.description: End date that's being used to filter the data members.

items.docs: Returns the collection of contacts that clicked the specified message link.
